title: Incident retro — ETA service outage (Sep 24)
tldr: A routine Redis failover turned into a 47-minute ETA outage across 312 fleets because three safeguards were missing: Redis topology refresh, retry jitter, and a circuit breaker. Detection and comms lagged (paged 6 minutes late, status page 26 minutes late), so customers like Brightside heard about it from their drivers first. Owners are assigned for all fixes, and Maya will ring-fence Q4 reliability capacity.
